description: Jovenes con el deseo de avanzar en la programación.
summary: We developed an interactive and web-based educational visual novel intended for students from elementary school. The story follows Alexander and his dog Chucho that are looking for their macaw friend Guacky that got lost in space. In their journey, they travel to Moon and Mars and meet different types of spacial equipment that explain their stories in first person. This way, kids can learn about planetary sciences and space history in an easy and accesible way.
details:
It's a web experience composed of independent, lightweight chapters integrated into a central web hub, telling a story while making the user travel through space while learning about the lost items nasa has provided us information with. Using VS Code and Ren'Py, we have made an intuitive, dynamic, and interactive novel that makes learning entertaining, because learning doesn't have to be something a kid should be avoiding but something a kid should enjoy doing. Our project also makes use of 3D models of the moon and mars, so the user can be visually attracted to continue exploring.

We've made a unique story that has unique characters that will be shared in a way that users from all ages could be interested in, a kid losing his pet macaw on outer space, goes on a trip to search for it and in doing so, he finds all sorts of machines that nasa has sent and don't come back to earth.
